title: Connect the calendars you already keep
body: Tempo reads all of them at once, so a dentist appointment blocks a sales call without you moving anything across.

title: Say when you actually work
body: Weekday windows, a buffer either side, a cap on the day. Set it once and every event type follows the same rules.

title: Share one link
body: The other person opens it, sees only the times that already work, and picks one. It lands in both calendars.
